# FwaEngineV1

<!-- generated by scripts/render.mjs from data/ ; do not edit -->

Midway's FWA integration: turns a funded `acquireFor` call into an FWA pack purchase and         drives that request to settlement, NFT delivery, or refund.

**Address**: not yet deployed. `midway-v1` is pending deployment.
**Source**: `src/midway/FwaEngineV1.sol`

## Functions

### State changing

| Function | Notice |
| --- | --- |
| `acquireFor(uint256,address,uint256,bool,(uint16,address))` | Acquires one pack for `account`. The FWA fee quoted here becomes FWA's own cap, so no         caller derives a cap and no reverse derivation exists to get wrong. |
| `activateListings(uint256)` |  |
| `autoResolve(uint256[])` |  |
| `claimAccruedRewards(uint256[],uint256)` | Claims each request's accrued surcharge allowance. The bound is derived here, not by         the caller: `minOut` may only tighten it, never loosen it. |
| `claimEpochRewards(uint256[],uint256[])` |  |
| `deliverNFT(uint256,address)` | Delivers a fulfilled allocation's NFT, or a recovered forced NFT, to `recipient`. |
| `makeManaged(uint256)` |  |
| `processAcquisitions(uint256)` |  |
| `recoverForcedOutcome(uint256[])` | Classifies each request whose FWA outcome was forced and records the resulting         incident. Idempotent: a duplicate id's second pass finds the incident already         recorded and nothing left to sweep, so it reports `changed == false`. |
| `recoverStuckNFT(uint256[])` | Pulls a stuck NFT from FWA into the request's clone and reclassifies it as a         deliverable forced outcome. A duplicate id in the same batch reverts: FWA no longer         names the request's clone as the stuck-NFT recipient after the first recovery. |
| `retrySharedUpsideActivity(uint256[])` |  |
| `settleForEth(uint256[])` | Accepts FWA's depositor bid and pays the recorded account. Unconditional: ETH is         always an acceptable outcome, so any caller may drive a fulfilled request to it. A         duplicate id in the same batch reverts: the second pass is no longer `Fulfilled`. |
| `settleForFwat(uint256,uint256)` | Accepts FWA's token bid under the caller-supplied `minOut` and deposits the result         into the account's RewardVault pot. Authorization is MidwayBuyer's job; this trusts         `onlyMidwayBuyer`. |
| `syncRequest(uint256[])` |  |
| `withdrawRefunds(uint256[])` | Withdraws the fee-reserve refund of each finalized request. A duplicate id in the         same batch reverts: `refundWithdrawn` is set on the first pass. |

<details>
<summary>`claimEpochRewards(uint256[],uint256[])`</summary>

Returns `amounts` parallel to `midwayRequestIds` so the Buyer can emit one      `MidwayRewardsClaimed` per id; an id repeated for several epochs sums into one entry.

</details>

### View

| Function | Notice |
| --- | --- |
| `acquisitionReadiness()` | Acquire-pacing signals read from FWA. A keeper sees a nonzero `unfulfilledVrf` when         FWA's VRF subscription cannot yet underwrite another callback and should call         `processAcquisitions` and wait before requesting again. |
| `activityOutbox(uint256)` |  |
| `canAutoResolve(uint256)` |  |
| `canDeliverNFT(uint256)` | Whether the recorded account may take delivery of the request's NFT. |
| `claimableEpochs(uint256)` | The epoch a request's acquisition landed in, whether it has closed, and the request's         acquisition count in it (the numerator of its share of that epoch's pot). |
| `economicsOf(uint256)` | The fee finalization record: measured spend, the charged fee, and the reserve         refund. Zero fields until `EngineRequest.economicsFinalized` is true. |
| `engineId()` |  |
| `engineVersion()` |  |
| `forcesEthSettlement(address)` | The delivery rule of section 4.2, for callers outside the engine (campaigns,         MegaRip2) that need to route acquisitions or accept auction targets consistently         with what the engine itself will force to ETH settlement. |
| `fwa()` |  |
| `fwaRewards()` |  |
| `fwaSettlementAmount(uint256)` | Amount realized by whichever settlement the request took: ETH proceeds or FWAT. |
| `fwaToken()` |  |
| `getRequest(uint256)` |  |
| `incidentOf(uint256)` | The incident record for a forced or stuck asset. `detectedAt == 0` means none exists. |
| `isRequestBuyer(address)` |  |
| `maxMidwayFeeBps()` | Upper bound on `MidwayFeeConfig.midwayFeeBps` this engine accepts. The Buyer         validates its own fee config against this value instead of holding its own cap. |
| `midwayBuyer()` |  |
| `midwayFeeReserveOf(uint256)` |  |
| `nextAction(uint256)` | The single action a caller should take on this request now. `callableNow == true`         means the call does not revert in the same block (I11). |
| `predictRequestBuyer(uint256)` |  |
| `quote((uint16,address))` |  |
| `refundAmountPaid(uint256)` |  |
| `registry()` |  |
| `requestBuyerImplementation()` |  |
| `requestDeadlines(uint256)` | FWA's settlement and finalize window ends for this request, from the listing's         allocation timestamp. Zero until allocated. |
| `rewardSplitter()` |  |
| `rewardVault()` |  |
| `sharedUpside()` |  |
| `splitAcquisitionFunding(uint256,uint16)` | Splits funding into the FWA budget and Midway fee reserve. |
